relationships.subject: claustrocingulate projection neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Inversely, chemogenetic activation of claustrocingulate neurons had no effect on basal nociception but rescued inflammation-induced mechanical allodynia.

relationships.subject: claustrocingulate projection neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Stimulation of excitatory claustrum projection neurons preferentially activates GABAergic interneurons, generating feed-forward inhibition onto excitatory cortical networks.

key_findings: Claustrum activity rises after painful stimulus and is attenuated in chronic inflammatory pain.
Inhibiting claustrocingulate neurons enhances acute nociception and blocks pain learning; activation rescues allodynia.
